name: Global Health - BA

sections.name: I. Lower-Division Core Requirements (three courses/twelve units)

items.label: One statistics course
items.notes: Listed as "MATH 11/11L"; COGS 14B has prerequisite COGS 14A.

sections.name: II. Upper-Division Core Requirements (four courses/sixteen units)

requirement.text: Global Health Field Experience: minimum one hundred hours distributed over no more than three programs, at a research, service, or clinical site in the United States or abroad, approved by the advisory committee. May be noncredit or credit bearing. Upon approval by petition, a student may enroll in a maximum of two Independent Study (GLBH 199) or Directed Group Study (GLBH 198) courses; this credit will count as an elective toward the major.

items.label: Three biological science courses (one must be upper division)
Three medical social science courses
items.notes: GLBH 111 may count toward two elective credits. CGS 123 if not used for global processes; GLBH/ANSC 129 if not taken for medical humanities; GLBH 160 and USP 147 if not taken for policy analysis requirement; SIO 116 if not taken for a global processes elective.

items.label: One medical humanities course
items.notes: ANSC/GLBH 129 if not taken for medical social science elective. (ANSC 190 is printed as "ANCS 190" in this list.)

items.label: One global processes course
items.notes: COMM 114J if not used for medical social science elective; CGS 123 if not taken for medical social science elective.

items.label: One upper division significant writing course from any major elective category
One additional upper division elective from one of the following categories: biological science, medical social science, or medical humanities

items.text: Eight of the ten electives must be upper division. At least one elective must be a global health (GLBH) course. "Students completing the honors thesis program can apply the course work [GLBH 150A, GLBH 150B] toward one medical social science elective and one medical humanities elective."

requirement.notes: A course may not be counted in two categories ("if not taken for ..." conditions).

narrative: All courses applied to the major must receive a letter grade of C- or better.
The Bachelor of Arts in Global Health (seventeen courses/sixty-eight units).
Eight of the ten electives must be upper division. Students must have course work across the major disciplines. At least one elective must be a global health (GLBH) course.
The major will require nine core courses.
